title: Dashboard drill-down drawer: auto-derived columns ignore the field's own label (headers fall back to humanized English keys in a zh-CN app) and list fields the object declares hidden
body:
eval#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AcTB69pEwZ9ugr1g1w

Filing gate: ① user-visible product defect with a named location, reproduced in the Console on the `os-dev-test` environment. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## What happened

A zh-CN OA app (package `app.c982`) has a dashboard whose widgets bind datasets over custom objects. Every field on those objects carries a Chinese `label` (no separate translation bundle). Clicking a bar or a table row opens the drill-down drawer, which lists the underlying records:

- **Headers are English, made from the field keys**, not the field labels: on `c982_expense_claim` the drawer shows `Subject · Reason · Attachment · Approval Status` where the object declares 报销事项 · 报销说明 · 其他附件 · 审批状态; on `c982_leave_request` it shows `Title · Leave Type · Start Date · End Date · Days · Reason`.
- **Hidden fields are listed.** `c982_leave_request` declares `title`, `start_date`, `end_date` as `hidden: true` (retired columns kept for their data; the live ones are `start_time` / `end_time`). The drawer shows exactly those three, first, so its "Start Date / End Date" column reads the record's save-time default (2026/11/12 下午5:13) instead of the leave period — a wrong-looking date presented as the leave's.

The same objects' list views (declared columns) and record pages show the Chinese labels and hide those fields correctly, so only the drawer's auto-derived columns differ.

## Where (read on `main`, `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx`)

- Header: `buildHeader` (~:934) → `fieldLabel(objectName, k, humanizeFieldKey(k))`. The fallback is the humanized key; the field definition's own `label` (`fieldsByName[k].label`, already loaded at ~:900) is never consulted, so a label authored on the field only shows when a translation-bundle entry also exists.
- Column set: `orderedKeys` (~:1097) filters `isSystemField` only; a field with `hidden: true` stays in.
- The drawer reaches this path through `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` (`ObjectDataTable` with no `columns`), so every dataset / chart / metric drill on a custom object is affected.

## Expected

- Header precedence: translation bundle → the field's declared `label` → humanized key.
- Auto-derived columns skip fields declared `hidden: true`, the way list views and record pages do. (Better still: derive from the object's default list view columns when it has one.)

## Steps

1. Custom object with Chinese field labels and one field `hidden: true`; a dataset + dashboard widget over it; publish.
2. Open the dashboard in the Console, click a bar / metric to drill down.
3. The drawer's headers are humanized English keys, and the hidden field is a column.

## Filing notes

- Business reason: the drill-down is how a manager checks which records make up a number; in a Chinese app it reads in English and shows retired columns with misleading dates.
- Reader who acts: the `ui/` dashboard seat (`plugin-dashboard`).
- Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `drill drawer column headers English field label` (8, QA runs only), `ObjectDataTable humanizeFieldKey label` (0), `drill-down columns hidden field` (4, unrelated), `dashboard drill down English headers` (6, QA runs / seat posts) — none on this.
